Streamlining Inventory and Purchase Requisition Processes with Rootstock In today’s
competitive business environment, efficient inventory management and streamlined purchase
requisition processes are critical for operational success. Rootstock, a cloud-based ERP
solution, offers robust tools to help organizations manage these crucial functions
effectively.

In this blog, we’ll explore how Rootstock enhances inventory and purchase
requisition processes, ensuring smooth operations and cost control. Purchase Requisition
in Rootstock 1.

Real-Time Inventory Tracking: Real-time visibility of inventory levels
across several locations and warehouses is made possible with Rootstock. This function
lowers the possibility of stockouts and overstocking by assisting firms in correctly
monitoring stock movements.

Users can track inventory by various criteria such as item
type, location, and status, ensuring precise inventory control. 2.

Material Requirements
Planning (MRP): The MRP functionality in Rootstock enables businesses to forecast demand
and plan inventory replenishment effectively. By analyzing historical data and current
trends, Rootstock helps businesses predict future inventory needs, ensuring that they
maintain optimal stock levels.

3. Automated Stock Movements: Inventory transactions, such
as receipts, transfers, and changes, are automated by Rootstock.

This automation reduces
manual errors and ensures that all inventory movements are accurately recorded. Additionally, the system supports cycle counting, allowing businesses to perform regular
inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies.

Enhancing Purchase Requisition Processes
with Rootstock 1. Simplified Requisition Creation: Creating purchase requisitions in
Rootstock is a straightforward process.

Employees or departments can easily enter
requisition details, specifying the items or services needed, quantities, and other
relevant information. This user-friendly interface ensures that requisitions are created
quickly and accurately.

They also record direct or indirect items or services required in
the order. This information is used to create the Purchase order upon approval.

2. Streamlined Approval Workflows: Rootstock’s purchase requisition module includes
customizable approval workflows.

Requisitions can be routed to managers or authorized
personnel for review and approval, ensuring that all purchases are justified and
authorized. This workflow reduces the risk of unauthorized spending and helps maintain
budgetary control.

Moreover, actions like emails, updates, notifications, and comments can
also be added at certain steps in the approval process. 3.

Efficient Conversion to
Purchase Orders: Once a requisition is approved, Rootstock enables seamless conversion to
purchase orders. Businesses can select suppliers based on predefined criteria such as
price, delivery time, and past performance.

This feature ensures that purchase orders are
created efficiently, speeding up the procurement process. 4.

Comprehensive Order
Management: Rootstock provides end-to-end management of purchase orders. Users can track
the status of orders from creation to delivery, ensuring transparency and accountability.

The system also supports goods receipt and invoice matching, verifying that deliveries
match purchase orders before payments are processed. Inventory Requisitions Inventory
requisition is the formal process through which an organization requests and authorizes
the use of specific items or materials from its inventory.

This process ensures that the
right quantities of necessary items are available for various operations, such as
production, sales, or maintenance, without causing overstocking or stockouts. Inventory
requisition is a critical process in managing the supply chain and ensuring that necessary
materials and products are available when needed.

Rootstock offers robust tools for
handling inventory requisition efficiently. Benefits of Using Rootstock for Inventory and
Purchase Requisition 1.

User-Friendly Requisition Creation Intuitive Interface: Users can
easily create and submit requisition orders through a user-friendly interface. Diversified
Requests: Templates divided based on the kind of purchase required (item or indirect
service or material) simplify the creation of requisition orders for common requests.

2. Seamless Integration Cross-Module Integration: Rootstock integrates seamlessly with
procurement, production, sales, and other ERP modules, ensuring a smooth flow of
information and processes.

Automated Purchase Orders: If required items are not in stock,
the system can automatically generate purchase orders which are processed upon approval. 3.

Real-Time Inventory Visibility Live Inventory Tracking: Managers may make well-informed
decisions by using real-time data on inventory levels. Dashboards and Reports:
Customizable dashboards and reports provide insights into current inventory status,
pending requisitions, and upcoming purchase orders.

4. Detailed Tracking and Auditing
Comprehensive Logs: Every requisition order is maintained with detailed information,
including who created the order, who approved it, and its current status.

Historical Data:
This historical data supports auditing, compliance, and trend analysis. 5.

Inventory
Optimization Avoid Overstocks and Stockouts: By providing real-time visibility and
automated workflows, Rootstock helps avoid the costs associated with overstocking and
stockouts. Demand Forecasting: Advanced analytics and reporting tools assist in
forecasting demand, enabling better planning and budgeting.

6. Mobile Access Remote
Accessibility: Users can access the inventory requisition system from mobile devices,
allowing for greater flexibility and responsiveness.

Real-Time Updates: Mobile access
ensures that users can receive real-time updates and notifications, regardless of their
location. 7.

Collaboration Tools Internal Communication: Built-in communication tools
facilitate collaboration among team members, ensuring that requisition orders are
processed smoothly. Supplier Communication: The supplier’s relevant information is always
maintained for immediate communication.

With integration and customisation, this can be
automated. 8.

Scalability and Customization Scalable Solutions: Rootstock’s inventory
requisition module is scalable to accommodate the needs of growing businesses. Customizable Workflows: Organizations can customize workflows to align with their specific
operational requirements and business processes.

9. Security and Compliance Data Security:
Rootstock ensures data security through robust encryption and access control measures.

Regulatory Compliance: The system supports compliance with various regulatory
requirements, providing peace of mind for businesses in regulated industries. Conclusion
In conclusion, Rootstock’s robust capabilities in inventory and purchase requisition
processing empower businesses to manage their supply chain efficiently.

By leveraging
real-time tracking, automation, and seamless integration, organizations can achieve
operational excellence and maintain a competitive edge in the market. If you’re looking to
enhance your inventory and procurement processes, Rootstock is a powerful solution that
can help you achieve your goals.
